provenance.note: Base single-journey fare (Monday to Saturday) read from official DMRC fare table rendered at https://delhimetrorail.com/fare. Published distance bands: 0-2 km (Rs 11), 2-5 km (Rs 21), 5-12 km (Rs 32), 12-21 km (Rs 43), 21-32 km (Rs 54), More than 32 km (Rs 64). Band edges are published as closed-open [min, max). No effective date is published on the official page, so effective_from is omitted and the record is loaded with provenance status unverified per milestone rules. Sunday & national holiday discounted fares (Rs 11-54), smart card discounts (10-20%), and time limits (65, 100, 180 min) are excluded per base single-journey scope. Airport Express Line is excluded due to station-to-station fare matrix structure.
